title: Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the predictive utility (Brier loss) of preference models across individual user personas, specifically measuring the performance on the 'Tail' (lowest-utility 10% of personas) to quantify representation disparities and supervision disadvantage.

Evaluating preference acquisition and downstream alignment (DPO) performance across distinct geographic and cultural datasets, such as Roleplay collections (Africa, Asia, North America, Europe, South America) and OpinionQA US regions (Midwest, Northeast, South, West), to measure how well the model accommodates diverse demographic preferences.
